rationale: The initial civic full-stack/Snowflake assertion is rejected against explicit repository nonintegration limitations. Independent fallback then licenses the canonical Stroke Risk Prediction pipeline solely for Python classification. It retains baseline/tuned metrics and recall tradeoff, and does not claim Random Forest civic work or LightGBM crash prediction. Project identity, heading-based Python support and source span match independently verified J01/S06 evidence.
